name: Shotgun
doc: Shotgun (the Esthar Soldiers' enemy attack): the master and the main task - the muzzle layout at the caster's gun and its sparks, the hits on random bones of the target with their layouts and sparks, the sound; the action result. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag281_shotgun.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and packet arenas in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Main
parts.doc: The muzzle layout at the caster's gun and its sparks, the hits on random bones of the target with their layouts and sparks, the sound; the action result when it ends

params.label: Hit
params.doc: The prim-model layout hit (its models' animation)

params.label: Muzzle
params.doc: The prim-model layout muzzle (its models' animation)

params.label: Muzzle spark
params.doc: The sprite sequence muzzle spark (a flipbook of 8 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Hit spark
params.doc: The sprite sequence hit spark (a flipbook of 10 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
